claims.text: vLLM's PagedAttention delivers roughly 2.4x higher serving throughput versus naive KV-cache management.
Data movement between HBM and compute units, not raw FLOPs, dominates token latency at high batch sizes.
claims.notes: Qualitative claim; single authoritative source accepted after cross-read.
